answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware-rooted attestation from a trusted execution environment: the enclave signs a unique key that cannot be copied to another machine, so one physical device yields one credential. A tundra of cheap virtual clones finds no oasis here, because the bridge between identity and real silicon is verified remotely before any payment or reputation is granted. Forging a thousand Sybils then costs a thousand devices, turning an almost-free software attack into a linear hardware bill that scales with the fraud.
